problem_statement: The measured model already exposes strong semantic readability and a writable symbol axis, but episode-local mapping from decoded semantics to the prompt-defined output symbol is weak and context-dependent. The training target should therefore be dynamic content-dependent binding/routing, not semantic relearning and not static steering.

external_method_inputs.use: Symbol tuning replaces natural-language labels with arbitrary symbols and improves flipped-label in-context following; this supports counterfactual arbitrary-symbol mapping as a relevant training pressure, not a fact about Clay's measured model.

A Transformer can learn systematic variable binding/routing in a controlled symbolic task; this supports mechanism plausibility only and does not establish the mechanism in the measured Qwen checkpoint.

central_hypothesis: The missing computation is approximately y = episode_codebook[semantic_class(x)]. semantic_class(x) is already substantially accessible, and the output axis is already writable; training must make the episode-local codebook causally control which symbol is emitted.

counterhypotheses.discriminator: Hold the codebook fixed and move the same semantic relation across structurally different templates. If semantic-class accuracy collapses before mapping is applied, add semantic robustness data rather than increasing only binding pressure.
A future same-model causal intervention must beat sham/nuisance/wrong-layer controls behaviorally on frozen holdout. Current T01 evidence does not.
Repair and bind one canonical promotion-gate lineage, then rerun. Instrumentation weakness can corrupt promotion decisions but does not by itself explain the observed chance-level behavioral result.
Use flipped S3 mappings, unseen ABI atoms, and prior-episode mapping reversals. A static class-to-symbol shortcut must fail these tests even if training-template accuracy is high.

preregistered_spec_resolution.class_word_policy: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN are permitted only inside an explicitly parsed [CODEBOOK] span; they are banned outside that span. A label-free demonstration-codebook variant may be a separately versioned ablation, but the two policies must not be mixed silently.

curriculum.objective: Before model training, prove realized class<->symbol mapping equals the selected S3 permutation, full six-permutation coverage exists, codebook order is independently randomized, class-symbol counts are exactly or at-most-one balanced, class-word leakage is fail-closed, semantic-bearing lexical families are split-isolated, and all emitted symbols belong to the measured accepted ABI alphabet.

Render the same semantic payload with the same atom set under multiple episode-local S3 mappings. The correct target must change only when the mapping changes. Also shuffle codebook-entry order while holding the mapping fixed; the target must remain invariant.
Train across at least four structurally different template families with split-isolated semantic lexical families and freeze a separate unseen-template family for holdout.

Place adjacent episodes that reuse the same atom set with different mappings. Reject previous-episode carryover, position shortcuts, stale mapping reuse, distractor mappings and malformed/ambiguous codebooks.
Mix EntityOS/HCU authority, causal transport, Hyperposition, GWT and effect-boundary method rows as retention data so narrow binding specialization cannot silently erase system invariants.
Positive J-Space hidden-state targets remain forbidden until same-Qwen3.5 model/runtime causal receipts exist. Behavioral binding examples must not fabricate vector-control labels.
